fetch_recipe: GET the recorded url exactly (raw Internet Archive id_ form) with no Accept-Encoding request header and no automatic decoding (for example curl -s -o FILE URL, without --compressed), then hash the bytes as received. A client that sends Accept-Encoding can receive an on-the-fly gzip body with different bytes, and a decoding client unpacks bodies that the archive stores compressed.

scope_note: Raw Internet Archive capture made 18 June 2021 of a post dated September 1, 2019 on the site of the leadership elected at Bloemfontein. The post reproduces the opening news text of SABC News, "PAC re-elects Mzwanele Nyhontso as president", by Makgala Masiteng, published 1 September 2019 at 11:24 SAST (https://www.sabcnews.com/sabcnews/pac-re-elects-mzwanele-nyhontso-as-president/), without credit. This is republished news text, not a primary PAC result declaration; its single claim remains claims only and never feeds a holder. The live original was consulted on 30 September 2026 only to identify authorship, not as a new historical attestation or replacement for the recorded archived response. Served without content encoding.

rows.role_title: President of the Pan Africanist Congress of Azania
rows.text: The PAC post dated September 1, 2019, reproducing SABC News text, says "Mzwanele Nyhontso has been re-elected as the president of one of the Pan Africanist Congress of Azania (PAC) factions, with Lunga Mantashe as his deputy", elected during the party's elective congress "held in Bloemfontein".

bounded_scope: PAC President observations for CLAUDE-C01-32 only (role za_pac_president on the PAN AFRICANIST CONGRESS OF AZANIA observation).
